intro.text: A tall scholar with a weakness for plaid, among the guests at Lady ZoBell's party in Elendel.

items.text: At the party Rame introduced himself to the man he took for Professor Hanlanaze, a scholar he had corresponded with; it was really Wayne in disguise. Rame had written on the "Higgens effect", which Wayne dismissed as trivial beside electrical fields, a subject Rame himself meant to study. Wayne then hinted that Hanlanaze had kept his own work on them quiet to get ahead, leaving Rame rattled.

appearance.text: Tall, and dressed in rather too much plaid.
